name: Raigad Fort
history: Raigad Fort served as the capital of the Maratha Empire founded by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. He was coronated here on June 6, 1674, establishing Hindavi Swarajya. The fort features the grand Maha Darwaja, the royal court, and the samadhi of Shivaji Maharaj.

name: Pratapgad Fort
history: Pratapgad Fort was built in 1656 by Shivaji Maharaj under the supervision of Moropant Trimbak Pingle. It is renowned for the Battle of Pratapgad in 1659, where Shivaji Maharaj defeated and slew Afzal Khan, establishing Maratha military prowess across the Deccan.

name: Sinhagad Fort
history: Sinhagad, originally called Kondhana, was the site of the legendary Battle of Sinhagad in 1670. Tanaji Malusare led a daring night assault to recapture the fort but sacrificed his life, inspiring Shivaji Maharaj's words: 'Gad aala pan Sinha gela' (The fort is won but the lion is lost).

name: Rajgad Fort
history: Rajgad Fort served as the first capital of the Maratha Empire for approximately 26 years before the capital was moved to Raigad. Shivaji Maharaj captured and fortified Rajgad around 1648, making it his political and military headquarters.

name: Torna Fort
history: Torna Fort holds the distinction of being the first fort captured by Shivaji Maharaj at the young age of 16 in 1643, marking the beginning of the quest for Hindavi Swarajya. Renamed Prachandagad, it stands as a timeless symbol of Maratha audacity.

name: Purandar Fort
history: Purandar Fort is renowned for the heroic defense by Murarbaji Deshpande and the historic Treaty of Purandar in 1665. Sambhaji Maharaj, the eldest son of Shivaji Maharaj, was born at this magnificent twin-citadel fort in 1657.

name: Shivneri Fort
history: Shivneri Fort is the sacred birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, born on February 19, 1630. His mother Jijabai stayed at this fort during his early childhood. The fort houses the temple of goddess Shivai and remains a holy pilgrimage of Maratha history.
